title_font.description: Font file for the title. Uses system font lookup.

watermark.description: Optional watermark text overlaid on the video (e.g. brand name).

mode.description: remove=jump cut, speed_up=fast-forward silence, mark=detect only

silence_threshold_db.description: Audio level below this (in dB) is considered silence. Lower = more sensitive.

min_silence_duration.description: Minimum silence duration in seconds to trigger a cut

padding_seconds.description: Seconds of silence to keep on each side of speech (prevents clipped words)

silence_speed_factor.description: Speed multiplier for silent segments (only used in speed_up mode)

aspect_ratio.description: Selector-friendly alias used to choose 1280x720 or 720x1280 when size is omitted.

duration.description: Alias for seconds. Must be one of 4, 8, or 12.

input_reference_path.description: Optional jpg/png/webp reference image for image-to-video.

backend.description: API backend provider to use for generation

model_variant.description: Model variant for FAL (e.g. veo3.1) or custom model for Google

image_path.description: Local reference image path for image_to_video

reference_image_paths.description: Local reference image paths for reference_to_video

operation.description: compose: low-level concat cuts + audio + subtitles. render: high-level — resolves asset IDs, auto-routes to Remotion for images/animations or FFmpeg for video-only. Preferred for compose-director. remotion_render: render via Remotion (Node.js). burn_subtitles: burn subtitle file into existing video. overlay: composite overlays onto base video. encode: re-encode to a target profile/codec.

preserve_existing_workspace.description: Pass through to HyperFrames to render an existing authored workspace without scaffolding or modifying managed files.

asset_manifest.description: Full asset_manifest artifact (required for render). Used to resolve asset IDs in cuts[].source to file paths.

proposal_packet.description: Full proposal_packet artifact. Optional but STRONGLY recommended — when present, final_review compares proposal_packet.production_plan.render_runtime against edit_decisions.render_runtime and flags runtime_swap_detected. Without it, runtime-swap detection falls back to checking edit_decisions.metadata.proposal_render_runtime.

narration_transcript_path.description: Path to a word-level transcript JSON (from `transcriber` tool output). Optional but STRONGLY recommended: when combined with script_path/script_text, final_review runs transcript_comparison and catches TTS failures like 'Chirp3-HD reads ... as the word dot'. Without it, content-level audio bugs ship silently.

script_path.description: Path to the source narration script (plain text). Used by transcript_comparison to diff against the transcribed audio. Provide this OR script_text.

script_text.description: Inline source narration script. Used by transcript_comparison when a file path is unavailable.

subtitle_style.description: ASS subtitle styling. Also extracted from edit_decisions.subtitles if not provided.

audio_path.description: Mixed audio to mux into output

profile.description: Media profile name from media_profiles.py (e.g. youtube_landscape, tiktok, instagram_reels). Applied in render and encode operations.

options.description: Render options (used by the render operation)

remotion_timeout_ms.description: Remotion render timeout in milliseconds, passed through as `--timeout` (governs headless-browser setup and delayRender). Raise this when the browser is slow to start (e.g. restricted networks). The subprocess timeout is widened to match.

preferred_provider.description: Provider name or 'auto'. Valid values are discovered at runtime from the registry.

preferred_provider_gap.description: Max weighted-score gap (0-1) within which an explicit preferred_provider overrides the top-ranked provider. If the preferred provider's best score falls more than this far below the overall top, the preference is ignored and the top-ranked provider wins. Default 0.15 — honors a preference unless it would drag selection to a drastically worse provider.

aspect_ratio.description: Video aspect ratio. Passed through to the selected provider.

duration.description: Duration hint (e.g., '5', '10'). Passed through to the selected provider.

reference_image_path.description: Local path to a reference image for image_to_video. Auto-uploaded if the provider requires a URL.

reference_image_url.description: URL of a reference image for image_to_video.

reference_image_urls.description: Reference image URLs for providers that support reference-conditioned video.

reference_image_paths.description: Local reference image paths for providers that support reference-conditioned video.

reference_video_url.description: Reference video URL for providers that support video-conditioned generation.

reference_video_path.description: Local reference video path. Providers that require URLs should reject this clearly.

image_list.description: Provider-specific list of image references, e.g. Kling Official Video Omni.

video_list.description: Provider-specific list of video references, e.g. Kling Official Video Omni.

element_list.description: Provider-specific element references, e.g. Kling Official element_id objects.

multi_prompt.description: Structured multi-shot prompts; not inferred from prose.

image_url.description: Alias for reference_image_url (used by some providers like Kling via fal.ai).

resolution.description: Resolution hint for providers that support named output resolutions.

api_family.description: Provider-specific API family hint passed through when supported, e.g. classic/turbo/omni.

model_name.description: Provider-specific model name passed through when supported.

mode.description: Provider-specific quality mode passed through when supported.

sound.description: Provider-specific native audio toggle passed through when supported.

watermark.description: Provider-specific watermark toggle passed through when supported.

callback_url.description: Provider-specific callback URL. Current OpenMontage providers still poll by default.

workflow_json.description: Optional full ComfyUI workflow JSON. Routes to a custom-workflow-capable provider (e.g. comfyui_video) based on server availability, not bundled model readiness. Requires output_node.

workflow_path.description: Optional path to a ComfyUI workflow JSON file. Routes to a custom-workflow-capable provider based on server availability. Requires output_node.

output_node.description: ComfyUI output node ID for a custom workflow_json/workflow_path.

workflow_name.description: Optional human-readable provenance label for a custom workflow.

workflow_model.description: Optional model/provenance label for a custom workflow.

workflow_model_stack.description: Optional provenance metadata for custom workflow dependencies.

clips.description: List of input video file paths

transition.description: Transition type: cut (default), crossfade, or fade (fade-through-black)

auto_normalize.description: Re-encode clips to a common format before concat if they differ

layout.description: Spatial layout for the spatial operation

pip_scale.description: Scale of PiP overlay relative to base video

pip_margin.description: Margin in pixels for PiP overlay from edges

dry_run.description: If true, return what would be done without executing
